exposure: Reduced as-needed opioid order following cesarean delivery (from oxycodone 5-10 mg every 4 hours to 5 mg every 6 hours)
outcome: Proportion of patients using >30 mg of oxycodone in the 24 hours prior to hospital discharge
finding: Reducing the as-needed opioid order after cesarean delivery significantly reduced the proportion of patients exceeding the recommended daily oxycodone dose for breastfeeding women, without negatively impacting pain control.
